# deezy config

Manages the config file. `--config`, before `config`, picks the file; otherwise DeeZy uses the one it finds. See [Configuration](../configuration.md).

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py: edit the parsers in deezy/cli, not this block -->

positional arguments:

## deezy config generate

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy config generate [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [--overwrite] [--from-args]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -o OUTPUT, --output OUTPUT
                        Output path for config file (default: auto-detect)
  --overwrite           Overwrite existing config file
  --from-args           Generate config from current CLI arguments (use with
                        encode command)
```

## deezy config info

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy config info [-h] [--path PATH]

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --path PATH  Show specific config file path
```

## deezy config validate

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
usage: DeeZy config validate [-h] [--preset PRESET]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --preset PRESET  Validate specific preset
```

## deezy config list-presets

```text {.scrollable-code-block}

options:

```

## Examples

- Write a default config:

```bash
deezy config generate
```

- Show which config DeeZy uses:

```bash
deezy config info
```

- Check a config file:

```bash
deezy --config my-conf.toml config validate
```

- List the presets with their commands:

```bash
deezy config list-presets --detailed
```
